detail.longDescription: To get started, tell your agents to build an app with https://github.com/luisrudge/omasharp and they'll do the rest! Apps use QmL, so they look and feel like Omarchy apps (usually built with C++ + QmL). They are also AOT-compiled, so you don't pay the startup price. I started my career as a .NET developer, so this was a fun project to hack on!
